title: Kagamine Len — The Twin Servant〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Riliane's Room

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: Allen, what do you have for me today?

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: Today is brioche, your Highness...

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (The girl that Riliane wanted gone isn't with us anymore.)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (And yet, the campaign against Elphegort continues...)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (Prince Kyle of the Kingdom of Marlon was the one who was originally betrothed to Riliane and decided to dissolve it to go after another girl.)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (We should be fighting against him and his kingdom instead.)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (But Riliane is still in love with Prince Kyle...)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (And because of that, she felt compelled to take her anger out on the people of Elphegort instead of him.)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (Even though they themselves did nothing wrong...)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (Now, the women of that land are being made to suffer...)

rows.Speaker: Three Heroes' Mage
rows.Line: This tidbit of information will be on me.

rows.Speaker: Three Heroes' Mage
rows.Line: This land, Lucifenia, will soon fall...

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line:
Even so...
I vow to protect it and Riliane!

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (In order to save Riliane from this fate, this war needs to stop.)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: Your Highness...

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: Hm? Yes?

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: Why continue waging this war?

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: The person who took your beloved away is...

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (My first love...)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line:
She is no longer with us.
Your goal has been fulfilled.

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: You know what happens to those who defy me, yes?

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line:
Yes.
I am asking knowing full well of those consequences.

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: Alas, it is as you say. That particular goal has been fulfilled...

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: But then, it dawned on me that I simply wished to control Elphegort myself.

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line:
This again?
You never change, your Highness.

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: Your desires know no bound. Be it wanting more treats or the moon. And you wastefully toss aside everything that you come to dislike.

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line:
(I have always obeyed her.
I was convinced that this was the only way to make her happy.)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (And now, my father and first love are both gone...)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (But I cannot allow things to stay their course. If they do, this land, and you will...)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: Your Highness, you must withdraw your troops at once. If you do not...

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: Hm? If I do not...?

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: I will leave the palace...

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: Wh-What...?!

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line:
Nonsense, Allen!
I would never allow that to happen!!

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: And what has gotten into you all of a sudden?! What is the meaning of all this?!

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: Quite a lot happened after that, but Riliane eventually agreed to my demands and called it a “special favor”.

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: Even after talking back to her, she let me remain by her side.

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: I felt needed.

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: And it genuinely made me feel happy...

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: The war would end and Riliane would be saved from her fate.

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: Or so I thought.

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: In the end, it was all too late.

rows.Speaker: Rebels
rows.Line:
“Hear our anger!!”
“End her reign of evil!!”

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: Just as the Elphegort campaign ended, the rebels rose up...

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: And I...

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: I was captured...
Lucifenian Palace - Dungeon

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (Ultimately, I couldn't stop that person's prediction from coming true.)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (But not everything will go as they say...)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (They said that Riliane would have to pay, but I am here in her stead.)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (Riliane...)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (Please, run. Just keep running...)

rows.Speaker: Soldier
rows.Line: It's time. Get up...

rows.Speaker: Citizens
rows.Line:
My son! How could you...?!
Give me back my big brother!!

rows.Speaker: Citizens
rows.Line: Daughter of Evil! Do you know just how many have suffered because of you?!

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line:
(All these people hate me...
They hate Riliane...)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (I'm glad she doesn't have to stand here.)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (Riliane...)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line:
(Don't worry, I'll protect you.
I just want you to live on somewhere and smile.)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (Hm? I hear waves...)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line:
(That takes me back...
This was where I told Riliane about our wishes...)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (After I told her about putting your wish in a bottle, she told me that she wanted to be reborn as a horse...)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: (Then, she asked me what I was going to wish for...)

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: If Riliane were to be reborn, I want to be reborn as well...

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: So that we can play together.

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: Goodbye, Riliane...

rows.Speaker: The Daughter of Evil
rows.Line: Ah, teatime.
